/* Discern SQL Engine (EJS) v. 3.17.3: Ref_pfv3_tpl_00_00 [60a65258-c3a1-420d-8862-a013810e92e5] */
SELECT DISTINCT
  e.ENCNTR_ID AS "Enc_Id",
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(e.ENCNTR_ID) AS "Enc_FIN",
  p.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED AS "Person_Name_Full",
  CWC_PER_FUNC.GET_MRN(e.ENCNTR_ID, p.PERSON_ID, e.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS "Person_MRN",
  omf_get_cv_display(e.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS "Enc_Loc_Facility",
  omf_get_cv_display(e.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD) AS "Enc_Loc_Nurse_Unit",
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_ATTEND_PHYS_NAME(e.ENCNTR_ID) AS "Enc_Attending_Phys",
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(e.REG_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS "Enc_Admit_Dt_Tm",
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(e.DISCH_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS "Enc_Discharge_Dt_Tm",
  pe.TOTAL_CHARGES_AMT AS "Total_Charges_Amt",
  pe.TOTAL_PAYMENTS_AMT AS "Total_Payments_Amt",
  pe.TOTAL_ADJ_AMT AS "Total_Adj_Amt"
FROM V500.ENCOUNTER e
  JOIN V500.PERSON p ON p.PERSON_ID = e.PERSON_ID
  LEFT OUTER JOIN V500.PFT_ENCNTR pe ON pe.ENCNTR_ID = e.ENCNTR_ID AND pe.ACTIVE_IND = 1
  LEFT OUTER JOIN V500.CHARGE c ON c.ENCNTR_ID = e.ENCNTR_ID AND c.ACTIVE_IND = 1
WHERE e.ACTIVE_IND = 1
  AND p.NAME_LAST_KEY < 'ZZ'

/* Discern SQL Engine (EJS) v. 3.17.3: Ref_pfv3_col_2a_14 [facd7329-b12c-4c56-a12f-791db7d79978] */
SELECT DISTINCT
  e.ENCNTR_ID AS "Enc_Id",
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(e.ENCNTR_ID) AS "Enc_FIN",
  p.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED AS "Person_Name_Full",
  CWC_PER_FUNC.GET_MRN(e.ENCNTR_ID, p.PERSON_ID, e.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS "Person_MRN",

  omf_get_cv_display(e.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD) AS "Enc_Loc_Nurse_Unit",
  omf_get_cv_display(e.LOC_ROOM_CD) AS "Enc_Loc_Room",
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_ATTEND_PHYS_NAME(e.ENCNTR_ID) AS "Enc_Attending_Phys",

  omf_get_cv_display(o.ORDER_STATUS_CD) AS "Order_Status"
FROM V500.ENCOUNTER e
  JOIN V500.PERSON p ON p.PERSON_ID = e.PERSON_ID
  JOIN V500.ORDERS o ON o.ENCNTR_ID = e.ENCNTR_ID AND o.ORDER_STATUS_CD NOT IN (2542, 2553)
WHERE e.ACTIVE_IND = 1
